Carlos sells 7 lemons per year at \(\$1.50\) each.  
\[
7 \times \$1.50 = \$10.50
\]

**Step 2: Calculate the annual net profit.**  
He spends \(\$3\) per year on water and feed.  
\[
\$10.50 - \$3.00 = \$7.50 \text{ per year}
\]

**Step 3: Determine how many years are needed to recover the initial cost.**  
The tree costs \(\$90\) to plant. Divide this by the yearly net profit.  
\[
\$90 \div \$7.50 = 12
\]

**Step 4: Conclusion.**  
After 12 years, Carlos will have broken even on his initial investment, meaning the tree will start earning him money from that point onward.

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
